content: The administration of paromomycin sulfate, like other antibiotics, may lead to the overgrowth of organisms that are not susceptible to the drug, including fungi. It is crucial to monitor the patient closely throughout the course of treatment. If new infections caused by resistant organisms emerge during therapy, appropriate interventions must be implemented promptly. This medication should be used with caution in patients who have ulcerative lesions of the bowel, as there is a risk of renal toxicity due to unintended absorption of the drug. The product contains FD&C Yellow No. 5 (tartrazine), which has the potential to cause allergic-type reactions, including bronchial asthma, in certain susceptible individuals. While the overall prevalence of sensitivity to FD&C Yellow No. 5 in the general population is low, it is more commonly observed in patients who also exhibit hypersensitivity to aspirin.
